verdict.rationale: Svelte ships first-party state management built into the framework itself. Runes cover reactive state: $state, $state.raw, $derived, $derived.by and $effect. App-wide shared state is supported through .svelte.js/.svelte.ts modules, and a community user independently praises Svelte Stores and Context for sharing state. Missing for 10: first-party docs for the stores API in the pack, and documented guidance on global/cross-app store patterns beyond a single mention of shared .svelte.js state.
